subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale exact-pin assertions are repaired, should the security workflow owner approve this grouped privileged-action update or require it to be split?
rationale: The model can verify official provenance and concrete test defects, but it cannot authorize merging an item carrying the protected security label across credentialed workflows.

options.title: Repair and approve the rollup
options.body: Update the four assertions, rerun focused validation, and approve the verified official action set as one coordinated maintenance change.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Separate token-minting, Codex, release, or security-scanning actions if the owner wants narrower review and rollout boundaries.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve the rollup
recommendation.body: Update the four assertions, rerun focused validation, and approve the verified official action set as one coordinated maintenance change.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows and guards to this team.
